verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a hardware processor, not a software agent or application, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself ships an MCP client capability. Copilot+ and the OpenVINO/oneAPI references describe host-platform software and developer toolkits, not MCP tool consumption by the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
